name: WebWallGL 3.0.0
body:
> 主版本：npm 发布物拆成三个包，`webwallgl` 解包体积从约 38 MB 降到 2.8 MB。桌面应用与渲染效果和 2.2.1 相同。· Major release: the npm package is split into three, and `webwallgl` shrinks from about 38 MB to 2.8 MB unpacked. The desktop app and rendering are the same as 2.2.1.
>
> ⚠️ 含破坏性变更：只用 `import … from "webwallgl"` 或 UMD `<script>` 的项目不受影响；用了子路径或 `webwallgl.min.mjs` 的请看下方「迁移」。· Breaking changes: projects that only `import … from "webwallgl"` or use the UMD `<script>` are unaffected; if you use the subpaths or `webwallgl.min.mjs`, see "Migration" below.

[简体中文](#简体中文) · [English](#english)

## 简体中文

### npm 包拆分

2.2.1 的 `webwallgl` 包解包后约 38 MB。其中约 27 MB 是 sourcemap，其余是同一份引擎被打包了四次（播放 ESM、播放 UMD、编辑器 ESM，各有可读版和压缩版）。现在拆成三个包，按需安装：

| 包 | 内容 | 解包体积 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`webwallgl`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/webwallgl) | 播放库：ESM（给打包器）+ 自包含的 UMD 压缩版（给 `<script>` / CDN） | 2.8 MB |
| [`@webwallgl/core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@webwallgl/core) | 引擎底座：scene.pkg / .tex 解析与解码、`fitWindow`；零依赖，可在 Node 里用 | 91 KB |
| [`@webwallgl/editor`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@webwallgl/editor) | 编辑器 API（可控时钟、可变场景图、拾取、单帧出图、scene.pkg 导出等），同时重新导出 `webwallgl` 的全部内容 | 276 KB |

- `@webwallgl/editor` 不再自带一份引擎，而是把同版本的 `webwallgl` 作为 peer 依赖，npm 7+ 和 pnpm 会自动装上，和你项目里的 `webwallgl` 共用一份
- `webwallgl` 的 ESM 不再内联视频解码库 `mediabunny`，改为普通依赖由包管理器安装；UMD 版仍然内联，`<script>` 直接引用照常可用
- npm 包不再附带 sourcemap；ESM 只发可读版（打包器会自己压缩），UMD 只发压缩版

### 迁移

| 2.x 写法 | 3.0 写法 |
| --- | --- |
| `import { … } from "webwallgl/core"` | `npm i @webwallgl/core`，然后 `import { … } from "@webwallgl/core"` |
| `import { … } from "webwallgl/editor"` | `npm i @webwallgl/editor`，然后 `import { … } from "@webwallgl/editor"` |
| `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl/webwallgl.min.mjs` | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl@3/+esm` |
| `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl/webwallgl.global.js`（UMD 可读版） | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl@3/webwallgl.global.min.js` |

导出的函数和类型没有改名，换掉导入路径即可。`import … from "webwallgl"`、`webwallgl.global.min.js` 与全局变量 `WebWallGL` 都保持不变。暂时不想迁移的话可以锁定 `webwallgl@2.2.1`。

### 下载与安装

| 平台 | 安装包 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple 芯片） | `WebWallGL-3.0.0-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS（Intel） | `WebWallGL-3.0.0-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-3.0.0-win-x64-setup.exe`（安装版）或 `…-win-x64-portable.exe`（免安装）；ARM 设备用 `…-win-arm64-setup.exe`；`…-win-setup.exe` 是同时包含 x64 / arm64 的合并安装器 |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`；ARM 设备用 `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb`；另有 `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

macOS 另提供 `.zip` 压缩包。安装包暂未签名：macOS 首次打开请右键选「打开」（或执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`）；Windows 在 SmartScreen 提示里点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。

也可以用命令行：`npx webwallgl-app`（打开桌面窗口）或 `npx webwallgl-app --web`（只起本地服务）。

---

## English

### npm package split

The 2.2.1 `webwallgl` package was about 38 MB unpacked. About 27 MB of that was sourcemaps; the rest was the same engine bundled four times over (player ESM, player UMD and editor ESM, each in readable and minified form). It is now three packages you install as needed:

| Package | Contents | Unpacked size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`webwallgl`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/webwallgl) | Player library: ESM (for bundlers) + a self-contained minified UMD (for `<script>` / CDN) | 2.8 MB |
| [`@webwallgl/core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@webwallgl/core) | Engine base: scene.pkg / .tex parsing and decoding, `fitWindow`; zero dependencies, works in Node | 91 KB |
| [`@webwallgl/editor`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@webwallgl/editor) | Editor API (controllable clock, mutable scene graph, picking, frame capture, scene.pkg export and more), also re-exporting everything from `webwallgl` | 276 KB |

- `@webwallgl/editor` no longer bundles its own engine. It takes the matching `webwallgl` version as a peer dependency, which npm 7+ and pnpm install automatically, so it shares the one in your project
- The `webwallgl` ESM no longer inlines the video decoding library `mediabunny`; it is a regular dependency installed by your package manager. The UMD build still inlines it, so a plain `<script>` keeps working
- The npm packages no longer ship sourcemaps; ESM is shipped readable only (your bundler minifies it) and UMD minified only

### Migration

| 2.x | 3.0 |
| --- | --- |
| `import { … } from "webwallgl/core"` | `npm i @webwallgl/core`, then `import { … } from "@webwallgl/core"` |
| `import { … } from "webwallgl/editor"` | `npm i @webwallgl/editor`, then `import { … } from "@webwallgl/editor"` |
| `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl/webwallgl.min.mjs` | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl@3/+esm` |
| `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl/webwallgl.global.js` (readable UMD) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webwallgl@3/webwallgl.global.min.js` |

No functions or types were renamed; only the import paths change. `import … from "webwallgl"`, `webwallgl.global.min.js` and the `WebWallGL` global are unchanged. Pin `webwallgl@2.2.1` if you aren't ready to migrate.

### Download and install

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `WebWallGL-3.0.0-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `WebWallGL-3.0.0-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-3.0.0-win-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `…-win-x64-portable.exe` (portable); ARM devices use `…-win-arm64-setup.exe`; `…-win-setup.exe` is a combined x64 / arm64 installer |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`; ARM devices use `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb`; there is also `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

macOS builds also come as `.zip`. The installers are unsigned: on macOS, right-click and choose "Open" the first time (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`); on Windows, click "More info → Run anyway" in SmartScreen.

Or from the command line: `npx webwallgl-app` (desktop window) or `npx webwallgl-app --web` (local server only).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl/compare/2.2.1...3.0.0

name: WebWallGL 2.2.1
body:
> 修复版：在 2.2.0 基础上修了一处渲染错误、清理了压缩产物里残留的注释文本。· Patch release: fixes one rendering bug on top of 2.2.0 and strips leftover comment text from the minified builds.
>
> ⚠️ 下一版 3.0.0 把 npm 包拆成了三个，并移除了 `webwallgl/core`、`webwallgl/editor` 子路径。如果你依赖这两个子路径、又暂时不想迁移，请锁定 `webwallgl@2.2.1`。· The next release, 3.0.0, splits the npm package in three and removes the `webwallgl/core` / `webwallgl/editor` subpaths. Pin `webwallgl@2.2.1` if you rely on them and aren't ready to migrate.

[简体中文](#简体中文) · [English](#english)

## 简体中文

### 修复

- **贴图通道子网格不再被当成普通几何绘制**：壁纸 3441873795 的 Kirby 泳圈右上方会多出两块缩小的碎片。原因是模型里有一个材质为 `puppettexturechannels` 的子网格（官方用来做眨眼的闭眼贴图覆盖层），它的顶点是贴图像素坐标，WebWallGL 却把它当普通网格画到了图层右上角。现在装配时会识别这类子网格并跳过绘制，静止（睁眼）状态与官方一致；眨眼机制本身仍未实现。本机全库 617 个模型中受影响的有 2 个（3441873795、3292361861）。感谢 [PR #15](https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl/pull/15) 的定位与诊断
- **压缩产物不再携带注释文本**：之前的压缩版里仍能看到 GLSL 和网页壁纸 shim 的中文注释。这些注释在字符串里（着色器模板串、按文本注入第三方页面的 shim），压缩器碰不到。现在构建时会去掉嵌入式 GLSL 的注释（契约注释 `// {…}` 原样保留），shim 也会先压缩再发布；压缩时中文不再被转义成 `\uXXXX`。延续 [issue #14](https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl/issues/14) 的工作。效果：shim 从 78 KB 降到 21 KB，`webwallgl.global.min.js` 从 1,189 KB 降到 1,080 KB

### 下载与安装

| 平台 | 安装包 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple 芯片） | `WebWallGL-2.2.1-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS（Intel） | `WebWallGL-2.2.1-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-2.2.1-win-x64-setup.exe`（安装版）或 `…-win-x64-portable.exe`（免安装）；ARM 设备用 `…-win-arm64-setup.exe`；`…-win-setup.exe` 是同时包含 x64 / arm64 的合并安装器 |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`；ARM 设备用 `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb`；另有 `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

macOS 另提供 `.zip` 压缩包。安装包暂未签名：macOS 首次打开请右键选「打开」（或执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`）；Windows 在 SmartScreen 提示里点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。

也可以用命令行：`npx webwallgl-app@2.2.1`（打开桌面窗口）或 `npx webwallgl-app@2.2.1 --web`（只起本地服务）。

### 渲染库（npm）

- `npm i webwallgl@2.2.1`；API 与 2.2.0 相同

---

## English

### Fixes

- **Texture-channel submeshes are no longer drawn as regular geometry**: wallpaper 3441873795 showed two shrunken fragments above the top-right of Kirby's swim ring. The model contains a submesh with the `puppettexturechannels` material (the closed-eye overlay the official engine uses for blinking); its vertices are texture pixel coordinates, but WebWallGL drew it as a regular mesh in the layer's top-right corner. Assembly now recognizes these submeshes and skips them, so the resting (eyes-open) state matches the official engine; blinking itself is still not implemented. 2 of the 617 models in a full local library are affected (3441873795, 3292361861). Thanks to [PR #15](https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl/pull/15) for tracking it down
- **Minified builds no longer carry comment text**: Chinese comments from GLSL and the web-wallpaper shim were still visible in the minified builds. They live inside strings (shader template literals, and the shim that is injected into third-party pages as text), which the minifier can't touch. The build now strips comments from embedded GLSL (contract comments `// {…}` are kept byte for byte), the shim is minified before shipping, and minification no longer escapes Chinese into `\uXXXX`. Follows up on [issue #14](https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl/issues/14). Result: the shim shrinks from 78 KB to 21 KB and `webwallgl.global.min.js` from 1,189 KB to 1,080 KB

### Download and install

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `WebWallGL-2.2.1-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `WebWallGL-2.2.1-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-2.2.1-win-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `…-win-x64-portable.exe` (portable); ARM devices use `…-win-arm64-setup.exe`; `…-win-setup.exe` is a combined x64 / arm64 installer |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`; ARM devices use `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb`; there is also `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

macOS builds also come as `.zip`. The installers are unsigned: on macOS, right-click and choose "Open" the first time (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`); on Windows, click "More info → Run anyway" in SmartScreen.

Or from the command line: `npx webwallgl-app@2.2.1` (desktop window) or `npx webwallgl-app@2.2.1 --web` (local server only).

### Renderer library (npm)

- `npm i webwallgl@2.2.1`; the API is the same as 2.2.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl/compare/2.2.0...2.2.1

name: WebWallGL 2.2.0
body:
> 正式版：2.2.0 已是 npm `latest`，取代 2.1.0；自 2.2.0-beta1 起又累积了 87 个提交。· Stable release: 2.2.0 is now npm `latest`, replacing 2.1.0, with 87 more commits since 2.2.0-beta1.

[简体中文](#简体中文) · [English](#english)

## 简体中文

这是 WebWallGL 迄今最大的一次更新。主角是**场景壁纸编辑器**：它和壁纸预览合成了同一个工作台，可以新建、编辑场景壁纸，并导出官方 Wallpaper Engine 能直接加载的 scene.pkg。编辑器整体按「万物即插件」重新组织，同时提供 **macOS / Windows / Linux 桌面安装包**，也可以用 `npx webwallgl-app` 一行命令启动。

### 本次新增（相对 2.2.0-beta1）

beta1 之后又落了 87 个提交，主要是把编辑器从「能改图层」推到「能像正经工具一样改」：

- **操控变形**：把一张图片转成按像素建网格的木偶（每根钉子一根骨、顶点权重按距离分配），在视口里拖钉子实时预览形变，再「记录关键帧」写进 .mdl 片段或直接烘焙
- **时间轴按属性分行**：每条动画可展开成按字段分行（位置 / 缩放 / 旋转 / 不透明度 / 颜色…），也能切回「全部字段」；选中关键帧后出现选择条（图层 · 字段 · 时间 + 删除 / 改平滑）；←/→ 挪 1 帧、⇧ 挪 10 帧、Delete 删除、双击在平滑与线性间切换
- **命令面板**：⌘K / ⇧⌘P 打开，命令与快捷键从注册表动态生成（插件登记的命令也在里面），另有「快捷键总览」页，不再手工维护
- **图层树键盘无障碍**：整棵树按 `tree` / `treeitem` 语义暴露，方向键与 aria 状态可被读屏识别
- **脚本生命周期模板（8 类）**：新建脚本时选 `update` / `init` / `applyUserProperties` / 指针事件 / 媒体回调 / `resizeScreen` / `animationEvent` / `destroy`
- **未保存文档找回**：意外关闭后重开，编辑器用横幅提示「发现未保存的草稿」，可恢复或丢弃；原壁纸库条目已删除时明确说明无法恢复
- **容器层与全屏后期层**：容器层的效果作用在整棵子树；全屏后期层把效果铺到整幅画面，可切「直通」（只作用在背板）与「全屏后期」（尺寸由引擎按画布覆盖）
- **效果库**：宿主枚举本机壁纸库里松散的效果目录，编辑器里可浏览、看参数与编译期分支（combos 勾选 = 写 1）、按引用加进工程；检视器里还能直接内联改外来效果的参数
- **场景与相机设置面板**：直接改这份壁纸自己的 scene.json（清屏与环境光、相机、相机抖动、鼠标视差、泛光 / HDR），写进工程、进撤销栈，和本机的「渲染选项」分开；文档里的未知键、`orthogonalprojection`、`camerapreview` 与脚本 / 动画包装保持原样
- **指针工作室**：停帧摆位 + 轨迹录制与回放（只在本机预览，不进导出），带轨迹列表与重命名
- **插件能力补齐**：7 个扩展插槽（toolbar / menu.add / menu.export / inspector.project / panel.right / statusbar / viewport.overlay）、`commands.register`、`ui.add`、插件源码可直接 `import` 独立 `.glsl`、粒子组件参数描述入口（`particles.components`）
- **插件管理面板**：每个插件的权限可逐项开关（默认全开、高风险单独警示、关掉立即按新白名单重挂），每个插件有可折叠的「插件日志」（最近 200 条、出错自动展开、只留在内存）
- **虚拟工程目录与工程类型**：新建工程默认存在浏览器存储（IndexedDB）并自动保存，也能打开 / 保存到本机文件夹；网页壁纸与视频壁纸现在也能各自开成工程（站点文件 / 视频原样保存，不参与图层编辑）；拖入图片、音频预览、渲染设置与效果署名一并补齐
- **系统实况与封面**：把系统正在播放的频谱与「正在播放」信息（歌名 / 封面）喂给引擎；播放器自己不给封面时，宿主按「歌名 + 歌手」去公开曲库补一张并缓存 30 天；编辑器预览停止试听、音量归零时会主动交还 macOS「正在播放」槽位，不再占住用户播放器
- **渲染引擎：眨眼机制按官方重写**：补齐每骨不透明度包络（MDL `blend_curves` → 顶点 alpha → `color.a *= v_VertexAlpha`），Puppet Warp 裁剪掩码块与「被裁剪件单独一趟绘制」也一并落地；此前用启发式伪造「眨眼压扁」的代码已整体删除，闭眼表现改为与官方同源

### 下载与安装

| 平台 | 安装包 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple 芯片） | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS（Intel） | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-win-x64-setup.exe`（安装版）或 `…-win-x64-portable.exe`（免安装）；ARM 设备用 `…-win-arm64-setup.exe`；`…-win-setup.exe` 是同时包含 x64 / arm64 的合并安装器 |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`；ARM 设备用 `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb`；另有 `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

每个平台同时提供 `.zip` 压缩包（macOS）。安装包暂未签名：macOS 首次打开请右键选「打开」（或执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`）；Windows 在 SmartScreen 提示里点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。

不想下载安装包的话，也可以用命令行：

```bash
npx webwallgl-app          # 打开桌面窗口（Electron）；装不上 Electron 时自动改用浏览器
npx webwallgl-app --web    # 只起本地服务，用浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:1431/editor/
```

常用选项有 `--library <目录>`（指定壁纸库）和 `--port <端口>`，`--help` 可以看到全部选项。

### 场景编辑器

播放与编辑在同一个页面：左栏「壁纸库」点一下就播放，同时可以直接改。新建的工程默认存在浏览器存储里（刷新、重开都还在）并自动保存；想拿到松散文件就「存到本机文件夹…」，或在工程卡上点「存到本机文件夹…」。壁纸库里的原文件永远不会被修改。

- **新建与打开**：新建空白或以图片为背景的工程；打开浏览器存储里的工程、打开本机文件夹，或把 scene.pkg 解成松散工程再编辑；网页 / 视频壁纸能开成各自的工程；图片、视频、音频直接拖进画面就成为图层；草稿可在意外关闭后恢复
- **图层**：图片、文字（文字 / 时钟 / 日期，可导入 ttf / otf 字体）、粒子（雪、雨、火花、光点）、视频（不是 H.264 的自动转码）、声音、模型、容器层、全屏后期层、相机与灯光层
- **画面操作**：点选、拖动、缩放、旋转；Alt + 点击在叠在一起的图层间切换；拖动时吸附画面边缘、中线和其他图层，显示参考线（按住 ⌘ / Ctrl 临时关闭）
- **多选**：⇧ / ⌘ 加选减选，一起拖动，批量删除 / 复制 / 成组，对齐与等距分布
- **图层树**：拖动排序、拖进拖出父层（画面位置不变）、成组、显示 / 锁定、双击或 F2 就地改名；支持键盘操作
- **关键帧动画**：位置、缩放、旋转、不透明度、颜色都能做动画；暂停在某一刻改值会自动打关键帧；时间轴按属性分行、拖动播放头、逐帧微调、关键帧复制粘贴；存为 Wallpaper Engine 原生动画格式
- **操控变形**：把一张图片变成按像素建网格的木偶，拖钉子拉形变并记录进片段
- **模型**：导入 glTF / GLB / FBX / OBJ / DAE / STL / PLY / 3DS，带骨骼的转成可动画的 puppet、否则转成网格；骨骼姿势编辑（视口里可直接点选骨骼）、动画片段增删、元数据与帧事件、材质贴图替换
- **效果**：颜色叠加、色彩调整、暗角、模糊、波浪、滚动、呼吸、描边、外发光、色差、像素化、扫光、渐隐遮罩，以及插件提供的效果；参数面板按参数表自动生成，支持多 pass；外来壁纸自带的效果能识别并在检视器里直接调整；「效果库」可以引用本机壁纸库里的效果目录
- **逻辑**：声明用户属性（滑条、颜色、开关、下拉、文本），绑到图层的可见、不透明度、亮度、缩放、颜色或文本上；给图层字段挂 SceneScript 脚本（8 类生命周期模板），边写边检查语法和入口函数，运行期报错定位到具体挂点
- **场景设置**：直接改这份壁纸自己的 scene.json 参数（清屏与环境光、相机、相机抖动、鼠标视差、泛光 / HDR），写进工程、可撤销
- **安全**：外来壁纸自带的脚本默认拦截，确认来源可信后可逐个放行
- **系统实况**：把系统正在播放的频谱与「正在播放」信息（歌名 / 封面）喂给引擎；播放器不给封面时按「歌名 + 歌手」在线补图
- **命令面板**：⌘K 打开，命令与快捷键都来自注册表（插件登记的也在里面）
- **检视器**分为属性 / 动画 / 模型 / 效果 / 逻辑 / 信息几个标签，只显示跟当前图层有关的
- **稳定性**：WebGL 上下文丢失时按当前文档自动重新挂载，编辑内容不丢
- **导出**：Wallpaper Engine 原生 scene.pkg（贴图编码为 .tex）、松散工程 zip、创意工坊上传用的目录、逐帧渲染的 mp4 视频、当前帧 PNG。导出前会用引擎自己的解析器把产物再读一遍做兼容性检查，有问题先写进控制台并让你确认

### 万物即插件

编辑器本体只剩一个很小的内核加页面装配。效果、shader 片段、粒子模板、模型导入、图层类型、检视器面板与标签、木偶工具、导出目标 / 钩子 / 检查规则、命令与快捷键、工具条按钮与 7 个界面插槽，全部由插件提供。内置功能本身也是插件，和外部插件走同一套装配、权限和生命周期。

- 页面只按注册表渲染，插件加进去的东西直接出现在界面上
- 任何内置能力都能被替换：再提供一次同名服务即可，撤下后自动回落
- 停用或卸载时，插件做过的一切按相反顺序撤销干净；贡献有一项不合法就整包回滚
- 依赖的服务全部就绪才启动，依赖消失自动撤下；连续出错 5 次自动停用，不影响编辑器
- 权限可事后逐项开关，每个插件另有自己的运行日志面板
- 无论装了什么插件，导出的始终是 Wallpaper Engine 能直接加载的工程

插件分两种：**数据插件**只有清单和效果 / shader / 粒子 / 词条文件，不运行代码；**代码插件**用 `@webwallgl/plugin-sdk` 编写，必须声明权限，安装时逐项确认，高风险权限单独警示。可以在「插件」管理里安装文件夹，也可以放进 `~/.webwallgl/plugins/`，改动后约 1.5 秒自动热重载。随应用自带 7 个示例插件（CRT 效果、多 pass 辉光、萤火虫粒子、点云导入、导出检查规则、检视器统计标签、对齐命令），默认已启用，也可以复制一份当作模板。完整写法见工作台「使用说明」里的「插件」说明。

### 渲染引擎

- **脚本**：补齐脚本沙箱 API（`getParticleSystem`、`getBoneIndex`、文字图层的对象方法等），对齐官方「先跑顶层、再按序 init」的两阶段初始化；本机全库实测 207 / 215 个脚本壁纸无报错
- **Shader**：对照官方补齐缺失的公共头，修复若干 HLSL → GLSL 转译缺口，转译漏掉的隐式类型转换按编译日志自动修复；Linear Light 混合修正；新增场景雾
- **模型 / 动画**：按官方补齐每骨不透明度包络（`blend_curves` → `g_BonesAlpha` → 顶点 alpha），Puppet Warp 裁剪掩码块与「被裁剪件单独一趟绘制」落地；此前用启发式伪造的「眨眼压扁」代码全部删除
- **粒子**：支持发射器的 delay / duration / 周期发射，此前这些字段被忽略、一直在发
- **动画**：多级父子联动组正确挂到根节点，不再退化成各自独立
- **解析**：修复全屏层子图层被错误平移 (+1920, +1080) 的问题
- **性能**：粒子着色程序按上下文共享，噪声倍频随密度档降级，模型矩阵与效果缓存复用；修复多路视频时诊断日志每秒刷屏约 120 条

### 渲染库（npm）

- `npm i webwallgl` 装到的就是本版 2.2.0（`latest`）
- 两个子路径入口：`webwallgl/core`（自包含、Node 可加载的引擎底座，如 pkg / tex 解析）和 `webwallgl/editor`（编辑器包，播放包的超集）
- 根入口 `webwallgl` 的播放 API 保持不变

### 其他

- 桌面应用 CI：推版本标签即自动构建三平台安装包并发布 GitHub Release
- 编辑器「使用说明」与 README 全面更新（时间轴、操控变形、效果库、场景设置、命令面板、系统实况等）
- 校验基线恢复全绿（稳定集 53 项通过 / 0 新失败）

---

## English

The biggest WebWallGL update so far. The headline is the **scene wallpaper editor**: merged with the wallpaper player into a single workbench, it creates and edits scene wallpapers and exports a scene.pkg the official Wallpaper Engine loads directly. The editor is rebuilt around "everything is a plugin", and this release also ships the first **macOS / Windows / Linux desktop installers**, plus a one-line `npx webwallgl-app` launcher.

### New since 2.2.0-beta1

87 more commits landed after beta1, mostly turning the editor from "can edit layers" into "can edit them like a real tool":

- **Puppet warp**: turn an image into a pixel-built mesh puppet (one bone per pin, vertex weights by distance), drag pins for a live preview, then "record keyframe" into the .mdl clip or bake it
- **Per-field timeline lanes**: every animation expands into lanes per field (position / scale / rotation / opacity / color…) or back into "all fields"; selecting a keyframe opens a selection bar (layer · field · time + delete / smooth); ←/→ nudges 1 frame, ⇧ 10 frames, Delete removes, double-click toggles smooth / linear
- **Command palette**: ⌘K / ⇧⌘P, with commands and shortcuts generated from the registry (plugin-registered ones included) plus a shortcuts overview page — no more hand-maintained list
- **Keyboard-accessible layer tree**: the whole tree exposes `tree` / `treeitem` semantics with arrow keys and aria state
- **8 SceneScript lifecycle templates**: `update` / `init` / `applyUserProperties` / pointer events / media callbacks / `resizeScreen` / `animationEvent` / `destroy`
- **Unsaved-document recovery**: after an unexpected close, a banner offers the draft back; if the source library entry is gone it says so plainly
- **Container and full-screen post layers**: a container layer's effects apply to its whole subtree; a post layer spreads effects over the picture, switchable between "passthrough" (backdrop only) and "fullscreen" (size overridden by the engine)
- **Effect library**: the host enumerates loose effect folders in your local wallpaper library, so you can browse them, inspect parameters and compile-time combos (checked = 1), and reference them into a project; third-party effect parameters are editable inline in the inspector
- **Scene and camera settings panel**: edit this wallpaper's own scene.json (clear & ambient, camera, camera shake, mouse parallax, bloom / HDR) — written into the project, undoable, kept apart from the local "Render options"; unknown keys, `orthogonalprojection`, `camerapreview` and script / animation wrappers are left untouched
- **Pointer studio**: freeze-frame pinning plus pointer-track recording and replay (local preview only, never exported), with a track list and renaming
- **Plugin contributions filled in**: 7 UI slots (toolbar / menu.add / menu.export / inspector.project / panel.right / statusbar / viewport.overlay), `commands.register`, `ui.add`, plugins may `import` a standalone `.glsl`, and particle component parameter descriptors (`particles.components`)
- **Plugin manager panel**: each plugin's permissions switch item by item (all on by default, high-risk flagged, applied by remounting against the new whitelist) and every plugin gets a collapsible log (latest 200 entries, auto-expanded on error, memory only)
- **Virtual project directory and project kinds**: new projects live in browser storage (IndexedDB) and autosave, and can be opened from / saved to a local folder; web and video wallpapers can now become their own projects (site files / video stored as-is, not layer-edited); image drop-in, audio preview, render settings and effect credits were filled in too
- **System live and artwork**: feeds the spectrum and now-playing info (title / cover) of what your system is playing to the engine; when the player offers no artwork the host fetches one by title + artist from public catalogues and caches it for 30 days; stopping preview playback or dropping the editor volume to zero hands the macOS "Now Playing" slot back instead of holding it
- **Blink mechanics rewritten against the official engine**: per-bone opacity envelopes (MDL `blend_curves` → vertex alpha → `color.a *= v_VertexAlpha`) plus Puppet Warp clipping masks and "clipped parts drawn in their own pass"; the heuristic that faked blinking by squashing parts is gone, so closed eyes now come from the same mechanism as the official engine

### Download and install

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-win-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `…-win-x64-portable.exe` (portable); `…-win-arm64-setup.exe` for ARM devices; `…-win-setup.exe` is a combined x64 / arm64 installer |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`; `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb` for ARM; also `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

`.zip` archives are provided alongside the macOS installers. The installers are unsigned: on macOS, right-click and choose "Open" the first time (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`); on Windows, click "More info → Run anyway" in SmartScreen.

Or skip the installer and use the command line:

```bash
npx webwallgl-app          # opens the desktop window (Electron); falls back to the browser if Electron can't be installed
npx webwallgl-app --web    # only starts the local server and opens http://127.0.0.1:1431/editor/ in your browser
```

Useful options: `--library <dir>` (wallpaper library) and `--port <port>`; see `--help` for everything.

### Scene editor

Playing and editing share one page: click an item in the Library tab to play it and edit it right away. New projects live in this machine's browser storage by default (they survive a reload or restart) and autosave; use "Save to local folder…" when you want loose files. Library files are never modified.

- **Create and open**: blank or image-background projects; open a project from browser storage, open a local folder, or unpack a scene.pkg into a loose project; web / video wallpapers become their own projects; drop images, videos or audio onto the viewport to make layers; drafts can be recovered after an unexpected close
- **Layers**: image, text (text / clock / date, with ttf / otf import), particles (snow, rain, embers, bokeh), video (non-H.264 is transcoded automatically), sound, models, container layers, full-screen post layers, and camera / light layers
- **Canvas**: pick, move, scale, rotate; Alt + click cycles through stacked layers; dragging snaps to canvas edges, center lines and other layers with guides (hold ⌘ / Ctrl to disable)
- **Multi-selection**: ⇧ / ⌘ to add or remove, drag together, batch delete / duplicate / group, align and distribute
- **Layer tree**: drag to reorder, re-parent by dragging (the picture doesn't move), group, toggle visibility / lock, rename in place with a double-click or F2; keyboard-operable
- **Keyframe animation**: animate position, scale, rotation, opacity and color; changing a value while paused adds a keyframe automatically; lanes per field, scrubbing, frame nudging and keyframe copy-paste; saved in Wallpaper Engine's native animation format
- **Puppet warp**: turn an image into a pixel-built mesh puppet, drag pins for a live deformation and record it into the clip
- **Models**: import glTF / GLB / FBX / OBJ / DAE / STL / PLY / 3DS — rigged models become animatable puppets, others become meshes; bone pose editing (pick bones in the viewport), add / remove animation clips with metadata and frame events, material texture replacement
- **Effects**: tint, color adjust, vignette, blur, wave, scroll, pulse, outline, outer glow, chromatic aberration, pixelate, shine sweep, fade mask and plugin-provided effects; parameter panels are generated from the param table, with multi-pass support; effects shipped with third-party wallpapers are recognized and editable inline in the inspector, and the effect library references loose effect folders from your local wallpaper library
- **Logic**: declare user properties (slider, color, bool, combo, text) and bind them to a layer's visibility, opacity, brightness, scale, color or text; attach SceneScript to layer fields (8 lifecycle templates) with live syntax and entry-point checks, and runtime errors pinned to the exact field
- **Scene settings**: edit this wallpaper's own scene.json parameters (clear & ambient, camera, camera shake, mouse parallax, bloom / HDR) — written into the project, undoable
- **Safety**: scripts in third-party wallpapers are blocked by default and can be allowed per wallpaper once you trust the source
- **System live**: feeds the spectrum and now-playing info (title / cover) of what your system is playing to the engine; when the player offers no artwork the host fetches one by title + artist
- **Command palette**: ⌘K, with commands and shortcuts built from the registry (plugin-registered ones included)
- The **inspector** is split into Properties / Animation / Model / Effects / Logic / Info tabs and only shows the ones that apply
- **Resilience**: if the WebGL context is lost, the scene remounts from the current document without losing your edits
- **Export**: native Wallpaper Engine scene.pkg (textures encoded as .tex), a zip of the loose project, a Workshop upload folder, a frame-by-frame rendered mp4, or a PNG of the current frame. Before exporting, the output is re-read with the engine's own parsers as a compatibility check; problems go to the console and you confirm before continuing

### Everything is a plugin

The editor itself is now just a small kernel plus page wiring. Effects, shader snippets, particle templates, model importers, layer kinds, inspector panels and tabs, puppet tools, export targets / hooks / rules, commands and shortcuts, toolbar buttons and 7 UI slots are all contributed by plugins. Built-in features are plugins too, sharing the same wiring, permissions and lifecycle as external ones.

- The page only renders registries, so whatever a plugin adds shows up in the UI
- Any built-in can be replaced by providing the same service again; removing it falls back automatically
- Disabling or uninstalling undoes everything a plugin did, in reverse order; if any contribution is invalid the whole package rolls back
- A plugin starts once all its services are ready and is withdrawn if one disappears; 5 consecutive failures disable it without affecting the editor
- Permissions can be switched off item by item later, and each plugin has its own log panel
- Whatever plugins you install, the export is always a project Wallpaper Engine loads directly

**Data plugins** are just a manifest plus effect / shader / particle / string files and run no code; **code plugins** are written with `@webwallgl/plugin-sdk`, must declare permissions, and are confirmed item by item on install, with high-risk permissions flagged separately. Install a folder from the Plugins manager, or drop it into `~/.webwallgl/plugins/` for hot reload within about 1.5 seconds. Seven example plugins ship with the app and are enabled by default (CRT effect, multi-pass glow, firefly particles, point-cloud importer, export lint rule, inspector stats tab, align commands); copy one as a template. See the "Plugins" guide under "User guide" in the workbench for details.

### Rendering engine

- **Scripts**: filled in missing sandbox APIs (`getParticleSystem`, `getBoneIndex`, object methods on text layers, and more) and matched the official two-phase init (top level first, then `init` in order); 207 / 215 script wallpapers in a full local library run without errors
- **Shaders**: added the official common headers that were missing, fixed several HLSL → GLSL translation gaps, and automatically repair implicit conversions the translator missed using the compile log; fixed Linear Light blending; added scene fog
- **Models / animation**: per-bone opacity envelopes (`blend_curves` → `g_BonesAlpha` → vertex alpha) plus Puppet Warp clipping masks and clipped-parts-in-their-own-pass drawing, all matching the official engine; the heuristic that faked blinking by squashing parts is gone
- **Particles**: emitter delay / duration / periodic emission are now honored (previously ignored, emitting forever)
- **Animation**: multi-level parent chains in linked groups attach to the root leader instead of falling back to independent playback
- **Parsing**: fixed child layers of fullscreen layers being shifted by (+1920, +1080)
- **Performance**: particle programs are shared per context, noise octaves scale down with the density level, model matrices and effect cache keys are reused; fixed diagnostics spamming about 120 log lines per second with multiple videos

### Renderer library (npm)

- `npm i webwallgl` now installs 2.2.0 (`latest`)
- Two subpath entries: `webwallgl/core` (a self-contained, Node-loadable engine base such as pkg / tex parsing) and `webwallgl/editor` (the editor package, a superset of the player)
- The root `webwallgl` player API is unchanged

### Other

- Desktop CI: pushing a version tag builds installers for all three platforms and publishes a GitHub Release
- The in-app user guide and README were brought fully up to date (timeline, puppet warp, effect library, scene settings, command palette, system live)
- Verification baseline back to all green (53 stability checks pass, 0 new failures)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl/compare/2.1.0...2.2.0

name: WebWallGL 2.2.0-beta1
body:
> 预发布版本：欢迎试用和反馈，生产环境请继续使用 2.1.0。· Pre-release: try it out and send feedback; stay on 2.1.0 for production.

[简体中文](#简体中文) · [English](#english)

## 简体中文

这是 WebWallGL 迄今最大的一次更新。主角是**场景壁纸编辑器**：它和壁纸预览合成了同一个工作台，可以新建、编辑场景壁纸，并导出官方 Wallpaper Engine 能直接加载的 scene.pkg。编辑器整体按「万物即插件」重新组织，同时首次提供 **macOS / Windows / Linux 桌面安装包**，也可以用 `npx webwallgl-app` 一行命令启动。

### 下载与安装

| 平台 | 安装包 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple 芯片） | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-beta1-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS（Intel） | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-beta1-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-beta1-win-x64-setup.exe`（安装版）或 `…-win-x64-portable.exe`（免安装）；ARM 设备用 `…-win-arm64-setup.exe`；`…-win-setup.exe` 是同时包含 x64 / arm64 的合并安装器 |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`；ARM 设备用 `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb`；另有 `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

安装包暂未签名：macOS 首次打开请右键选「打开」（或执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`）；Windows 在 SmartScreen 提示里点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。

不想下载安装包的话，也可以用命令行：

```bash
npx webwallgl-app          # 打开桌面窗口（Electron）；装不上 Electron 时自动改用浏览器
npx webwallgl-app --web    # 只起本地服务，用浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:1431/editor/
```

常用选项有 `--library <目录>`（指定壁纸库）和 `--port <端口>`，`--help` 可以看到全部选项。

渲染库的 npm 预发布版本：`npm i webwallgl@beta`（`latest` 仍是 2.1.0）。

### 场景编辑器

播放与编辑在同一个页面：左栏「壁纸库」点一下就播放，同时可以直接改。改动先留在内存里，按 ⌘S 另存为项目文件夹后自动保存，壁纸库里的原文件永远不会被修改。

- **新建与打开**：新建空白或以图片为背景的项目；打开项目文件夹，或把 scene.pkg 解成松散工程再编辑；图片、视频、音频直接拖进画面就成为图层；草稿可在意外关闭后恢复
- **图层**：图片、文字（文字 / 时钟 / 日期，可导入 ttf / otf 字体）、粒子（雪、雨、火花、光点）、视频（不是 H.264 的自动转码）、声音、模型
- **画面操作**：点选、拖动、缩放、旋转；Alt + 点击在叠在一起的图层间切换；拖动时吸附画面边缘、中线和其他图层，显示参考线（按住 ⌘ / Ctrl 临时关闭）
- **多选**：⇧ / ⌘ 加选减选，一起拖动，批量删除 / 复制 / 成组，对齐与等距分布
- **图层树**：拖动排序、拖进拖出父层（画面位置不变）、成组、显示 / 锁定、双击或 F2 就地改名
- **关键帧动画**：位置、缩放、旋转、不透明度、颜色都能做动画；暂停在某一刻改值会自动打关键帧；时间轴上按图层显示动画条，可拖动关键帧改时刻、复制粘贴；存为 Wallpaper Engine 原生动画格式
- **模型**：导入 glTF / GLB / FBX / OBJ / DAE / STL / PLY / 3DS，带骨骼的转成可动画的 puppet、否则转成网格；骨骼姿势编辑（视口里可直接点选骨骼）、动画片段增删、元数据与帧事件、材质贴图替换；还能把一张图片变成会摆动的网格
- **效果**：颜色叠加、色彩调整、暗角、模糊、波浪、滚动、呼吸、描边、外发光、色差、像素化、扫光、渐隐遮罩，以及插件提供的效果；参数面板按参数表自动生成，支持多 pass；外来壁纸自带的效果也能识别和调整
- **逻辑**：声明用户属性（滑条、颜色、开关、下拉、文本），绑到图层的可见、不透明度、亮度、缩放、颜色或文本上；给图层字段挂 SceneScript 脚本，边写边检查语法和入口函数，运行期报错定位到具体挂点
- **安全**：外来壁纸自带的脚本默认拦截，确认来源可信后可逐个放行
- **检视器**分为属性 / 动画 / 模型 / 效果 / 逻辑 / 信息几个标签，只显示跟当前图层有关的
- **稳定性**：WebGL 上下文丢失时按当前文档自动重新挂载，编辑内容不丢
- **导出**：Wallpaper Engine 原生 scene.pkg（贴图编码为 .tex）、松散工程 zip、创意工坊上传用的目录、逐帧渲染的 mp4 视频、当前帧 PNG。导出前会用引擎自己的解析器把产物再读一遍做兼容性检查，有问题先写进控制台并让你确认

### 万物即插件

编辑器本体只剩一个很小的内核加页面装配。效果、shader 片段、粒子模板、模型导入、图层类型、检视器面板与标签、木偶工具、导出目标 / 钩子 / 检查规则、命令与快捷键、工具条按钮，全部由插件提供。内置功能本身也是插件，和外部插件走同一套装配、权限和生命周期。

- 页面只按注册表渲染，插件加进去的东西直接出现在界面上
- 任何内置能力都能被替换：再提供一次同名服务即可，撤下后自动回落
- 停用或卸载时，插件做过的一切按相反顺序撤销干净；贡献有一项不合法就整包回滚
- 依赖的服务全部就绪才启动，依赖消失自动撤下；连续出错 5 次自动停用，不影响编辑器
- 无论装了什么插件，导出的始终是 Wallpaper Engine 能直接加载的工程

插件分两种：**数据插件**只有清单和效果 / shader / 粒子 / 词条文件，不运行代码；**代码插件**用 `@webwallgl/plugin-sdk` 编写，必须声明权限，安装时逐项确认，高风险权限单独警示。可以在「插件」管理里安装文件夹，也可以放进 `~/.webwallgl/plugins/`，改动后约 1.5 秒自动热重载。随应用自带 7 个示例插件（CRT 效果、多 pass 辉光、萤火虫粒子、点云导入、导出检查规则、检视器统计标签、对齐命令），默认已启用，也可以复制一份当作模板。完整写法见工作台「使用说明」里的「插件」说明。

### 渲染引擎

- **脚本**：补齐脚本沙箱 API（`getParticleSystem`、`getBoneIndex`、文字图层的对象方法等），对齐官方「先跑顶层、再按序 init」的两阶段初始化；本机全库实测 207 / 215 个脚本壁纸无报错
- **Shader**：对照官方补齐缺失的公共头，修复若干 HLSL → GLSL 转译缺口，转译漏掉的隐式类型转换按编译日志自动修复；Linear Light 混合修正；新增场景雾
- **粒子**：支持发射器的 delay / duration / 周期发射，此前这些字段被忽略、一直在发
- **动画**：多级父子联动组正确挂到根节点，不再退化成各自独立
- **解析**：修复全屏层子图层被错误平移 (+1920, +1080) 的问题
- **性能**：粒子着色程序按上下文共享，噪声倍频随密度档降级，模型矩阵与效果缓存复用；修复多路视频时诊断日志每秒刷屏约 120 条

### 渲染库（npm）

- 新增两个子路径入口：`webwallgl/core`（自包含、Node 可加载的引擎底座，如 pkg / tex 解析）和 `webwallgl/editor`（编辑器包，播放包的超集）
- 根入口 `webwallgl` 的播放 API 保持不变

### 其他

- 新增桌面应用 CI：推版本标签即自动构建三平台安装包并发布 GitHub Release
- 校验基线恢复全绿
- README 补充编辑器能力、插件设计与桌面应用说明

## English

The biggest WebWallGL update so far. The headline is the **scene wallpaper editor**: merged with the wallpaper player into a single workbench, it creates and edits scene wallpapers and exports a scene.pkg the official Wallpaper Engine loads directly. The editor is rebuilt around "everything is a plugin", and this release also ships the first **macOS / Windows / Linux desktop installers**, plus a one-line `npx webwallgl-app` launcher.

### Download and install

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-beta1-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-beta1-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `WebWallGL-2.2.0-beta1-win-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `…-win-x64-portable.exe` (portable); `…-win-arm64-setup.exe` for ARM devices; `…-win-setup.exe` is a combined x64 / arm64 installer |
| Linux | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` / `…-linux-amd64.deb`; `…-linux-arm64.AppImage` / `…-linux-arm64.deb` for ARM; also `…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

The installers are unsigned: on macOS, right-click and choose "Open" the first time (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WebWallGL.app`); on Windows, click "More info → Run anyway" in SmartScreen.

Or skip the installer and use the command line:

```bash
npx webwallgl-app          # opens the desktop window (Electron); falls back to the browser if Electron can't be installed
npx webwallgl-app --web    # only starts the local server and opens http://127.0.0.1:1431/editor/ in your browser
```

Useful options: `--library <dir>` (wallpaper library) and `--port <port>`; see `--help` for everything.

Renderer library pre-release on npm: `npm i webwallgl@beta` (`latest` stays at 2.1.0).

### Scene editor

Playing and editing share one page: click an item in the Library tab to play it and edit it right away. Changes stay in memory until ⌘S saves them as a project folder, after which they autosave; library files are never modified.

- **Create and open**: blank or image-background projects; open a project folder or unpack a scene.pkg into a loose project; drop images, videos or audio onto the viewport to make layers; drafts can be recovered after an unexpected close
- **Layers**: image, text (text / clock / date, with ttf / otf import), particles (snow, rain, embers, bokeh), video (non-H.264 is transcoded automatically), sound and models
- **Canvas**: pick, move, scale, rotate; Alt + click cycles through stacked layers; dragging snaps to canvas edges, center lines and other layers with guides (hold ⌘ / Ctrl to disable)
- **Multi-selection**: ⇧ / ⌘ to add or remove, drag together, batch delete / duplicate / group, align and distribute
- **Layer tree**: drag to reorder, re-parent by dragging (the picture doesn't move), group, toggle visibility / lock, rename in place with a double-click or F2
- **Keyframe animation**: animate position, scale, rotation, opacity and color; changing a value while paused adds a keyframe automatically; the timeline shows per-layer animation bars, keyframes can be dragged in time and copy-pasted; saved in Wallpaper Engine's native animation format
- **Models**: import glTF / GLB / FBX / OBJ / DAE / STL / PLY / 3DS — rigged models become animatable puppets, others become meshes; bone pose editing (pick bones in the viewport), add / remove animation clips with metadata and frame events, material texture replacement; or turn an image into a swaying mesh
- **Effects**: tint, color adjust, vignette, blur, wave, scroll, pulse, outline, outer glow, chromatic aberration, pixelate, shine sweep, fade mask and plugin-provided effects; parameter panels are generated from the param table, with multi-pass support; effects shipped with third-party wallpapers are recognized and adjustable
- **Logic**: declare user properties (slider, color, bool, combo, text) and bind them to a layer's visibility, opacity, brightness, scale, color or text; attach SceneScript to layer fields with live syntax and entry-point checks, and runtime errors pinned to the exact field
- **Safety**: scripts in third-party wallpapers are blocked by default and can be allowed per wallpaper once you trust the source
- The **inspector** is split into Properties / Animation / Model / Effects / Logic / Info tabs and only shows the ones that apply
- **Resilience**: if the WebGL context is lost, the scene remounts from the current document without losing your edits
- **Export**: native Wallpaper Engine scene.pkg (textures encoded as .tex), a zip of the loose project, a Workshop upload folder, a frame-by-frame rendered mp4, or a PNG of the current frame. Before exporting, the output is re-read with the engine's own parsers as a compatibility check; problems go to the console and you confirm before continuing

### Everything is a plugin

The editor itself is now just a small kernel plus page wiring. Effects, shader snippets, particle templates, model importers, layer kinds, inspector panels and tabs, puppet tools, export targets / hooks / rules, commands and shortcuts, and toolbar buttons are all contributed by plugins. Built-in features are plugins too, sharing the same wiring, permissions and lifecycle as external ones.

- The page only renders registries, so whatever a plugin adds shows up in the UI
- Any built-in can be replaced by providing the same service again; removing it falls back automatically
- Disabling or uninstalling undoes everything a plugin did, in reverse order; if any contribution is invalid the whole package rolls back
- A plugin starts once all its services are ready and is withdrawn if one disappears; 5 consecutive failures disable it without affecting the editor
- Whatever plugins you install, the export is always a project Wallpaper Engine loads directly

**Data plugins** are just a manifest plus effect / shader / particle / string files and run no code; **code plugins** are written with `@webwallgl/plugin-sdk`, must declare permissions, and are confirmed item by item on install, with high-risk permissions flagged separately. Install a folder from the Plugins manager, or drop it into `~/.webwallgl/plugins/` for hot reload within about 1.5 seconds. Seven example plugins ship with the app and are enabled by default (CRT effect, multi-pass glow, firefly particles, point-cloud importer, export lint rule, inspector stats tab, align commands); copy one as a template. See the "Plugins" guide under "User guide" in the workbench for details.

### Rendering engine

- **Scripts**: filled in missing sandbox APIs (`getParticleSystem`, `getBoneIndex`, object methods on text layers, and more) and matched the official two-phase init (top level first, then `init` in order); 207 / 215 script wallpapers in a full local library run without errors
- **Shaders**: added the official common headers that were missing, fixed several HLSL → GLSL translation gaps, and automatically repair implicit conversions the translator missed using the compile log; fixed Linear Light blending; added scene fog
- **Particles**: emitter delay / duration / periodic emission are now honored (previously ignored, emitting forever)
- **Animation**: multi-level parent chains in linked groups attach to the root leader instead of falling back to independent playback
- **Parsing**: fixed child layers of fullscreen layers being shifted by (+1920, +1080)
- **Performance**: particle programs are shared per context, noise octaves scale down with the density level, model matrices and effect cache keys are reused; fixed diagnostics spamming about 120 log lines per second with multiple videos

### Renderer library (npm)

- Two new subpath entries: `webwallgl/core` (a self-contained, Node-loadable engine base such as pkg / tex parsing) and `webwallgl/editor` (the editor package, a superset of the player)
- The root `webwallgl` player API is unchanged

### Other

- New desktop CI: pushing a version tag builds installers for all three platforms and publishes a GitHub Release
- Verification baseline back to all green
- README now covers editor features, the plugin design and the desktop app
